answer: Rotating-witness bond: every new identity locks 150 POA for 20 epochs, and each epoch a random 10% of identities must pass a live audit or lose 40% of the bond. Faking 1,000 identities freezes 150,000 POA and loses about 6,000 POA per epoch to audits, so cost grows with count. A raven-sharp auditor set is drawn on-chain and checkable by anyone; like a fable, a fake persona rarely survives repeated questions, and karst-style hidden cracks surface under audit. Honest users just wait out the 20 epochs.
